    Independent practice resource. Original practice prompts; not affiliated with or endorsed by IELTS. Theme-linked Part 1 questions are a learning activity; the real interview covers a range of familiar topics.

    PART 1 · A QUICK REMINDER

    Plan now. Speak with confidence.

    There is no note-taking in Parts 1 and 3 of the real IELTS Speaking test. You answer the examiner’s questions directly.

    ✎

    Here, we’re building the skill.

    Taking short notes and organising your ideas is a useful starting point for studying. Use this planner to build clear answers. As you gain confidence, practise speaking without notes too.

    WHEN YOU REACH PART 2

    In the real test, you get one minute to prepare and paper and a pencil for notes. When you reach Part 2 here, make a short keyword plan before speaking.
